resources.string: Jarvys sends this signed APK to Android PackageInstaller. Android controls compatibility, installation results, and any confirmation shown by the system.

Android requires permission for Jarvys to install apps from this source. Open Android settings for Jarvys, enable this permission, return here, and submit a new installation request.

Android installation is unavailable in this distribution or on this device. The signed APK remains in the project.
